portInfo.description: Europe's largest port and a modern city, known for innovative architecture and excellent cruise terminal facilities.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Cruise Terminal Rotterdam — Wilhelminakade 699, 3072 AP Rotterdam (building also indexed near 3072 MK)
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Cruise Port Rotterdam places the terminal on Wilhelminapier with taxis, bus parking and public transport described as about a one-minute walk. Cruise-line materials commonly cite Wilhelminaplein metro at about a four-minute walk—treat both as operator/line estimates and confirm in RET for the call date. From Rotterdam Centraal: allow an editorial 20–35 minutes door-to-door including metro/tram, walking and orientation (estimate; NS/RET-verify). Schiphol (AMS): plan via NS to Rotterdam Centraal then RET; do not compress below a 90-minute risk buffer airport-to-gangway on embarkation day without a live journey plan. Resolve passenger paperwork showing Wilhelminakade 699 (operator) versus 669 (some cruise-line pages) before rideshare drop-off—both refer to the Wilhelminapier complex.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Markthal (Market Hall), Dominee Jan Scharpstraat: allow 45–75 minutes for food stalls and the arched interior.
Euromast: allow 60–90 minutes including tickets and views; skip if wind/queue risk is high on a short call.
Wilhelminapier / Kop van Zuid waterfront walk from the terminal: allow 45–60 minutes without riding anywhere.
Cube Houses / Blaak area: allow ~60 minutes when combining with Markthal.
Erasmusbrug photo stop: allow 20–30 minutes as a connector between pier and centre.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: Add a harbour ferry hop or Museumpark only with confirmed timings; keep 120 minutes uncommitted ship buffer on a 9-hour clock. Overnight needs reboarding confirmation. Do not treat Delft or The Hague as casual add-ons without a full rail plan and ship approval.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Resolve 699 vs 669 on your boarding pass before rideshare drop-off—both refer to the Wilhelminapier complex, but drivers follow the number you give.
